notes: Skill tiers borrowed from Perfect Dark's simulants, which are the reference design: Rare shipped six graded opponents in this engine lineage and players still describe them by name twenty-five years later, which is the strongest evidence available that the gradation works.

The important part is that the tiers differ on MORE than accuracy. A bot that only shoots worse is a bot that feels identical and merely loses; Rare varied speed, hearing, weapon-seeking priority and behavioural complexity together, so a weak simulant plays like a novice rather than like an expert with a handicap.
Every opcode named here is checked against src/bondaicommands.h by tools/gen_bot_archetypes.py.

archetypes.name: meat
archetypes.summary: An absolute novice. Moves slowly, sweeps its aim across a target rather than tracking it, and hits roughly one shot in ten.
behaviour: Does not seek weapons or armour; fights with whatever it spawned holding.
Turns toward a target and fires without leading or tracking it.
No evasion at all -- does not sidestep, roll or take cover.

archetypes.name: easy
archetypes.summary: A beginner. Still slower than a person, still inaccurate, but it moves with some intent rather than wandering.
behaviour: Will pick up a better weapon if it walks over one, but does not route to them.
Fires while walking rather than standing still to shoot.
Reacts to being shot, but slowly.

archetypes.name: normal
archetypes.summary: An average player. Moves at human speed, hits a bit more than half its shots, and fights competently without doing anything clever.
behaviour: Routes to weapons and armour when not in a fight.
Uses basic evasion -- sidesteps while firing.
Investigates sounds rather than only reacting to what it sees.

archetypes.name: hard
archetypes.summary: A good player. Slightly faster than human, accurate, and it evades properly instead of trading shots in the open.
behaviour: Prioritises armour, and returns to it after fights.
Rolls and hops sideways under fire rather than only strafing.
Retreats from a fight it is losing instead of committing to it.

archetypes.name: perfect
archetypes.summary: An expert. Secures weapons and ammunition first, then hunts, and shoots almost everything it aims at.
behaviour: Opens by collecting weapons and ammunition as fast as possible, and only then seeks fights.
Tracks a target through cover and fires the instant it reappears, rather than reacquiring.
Loses only to a genuinely better weapon rather than to better play.

archetypes.name: dark
archetypes.summary: Beyond expert. Effectively always knows where opponents are and rarely fails at what it sets out to do.
behaviour: Perfect accuracy except against a moving target that is using cover, which is the one deliberate weakness left in it.
Effectively omniscient about opponent position rather than dependent on line of sight.
Pursues relentlessly and does not lose track of a target that breaks contact.
